resolve_provider_full: resolve a provider name through built-in aliases, models.dev catalog, and user config to get a ProviderDef
normalize_provider: normalize a provider name by resolving aliases and casing to a canonical provider id
get_provider: look up a built-in provider by id or alias merging models.dev data with Hermes overlays
determine_api_mode: determine the wire protocol API mode for a provider based on transport or URL heuristics
get_label: get a human-readable display name for a provider id using overrides and models.dev catalog
is_aggregator: check whether a provider is a multi-model aggregator endpoint
resolve_user_provider: resolve a custom provider from the user config providers dict section
resolve_custom_provider: resolve a saved custom provider from the custom_providers list in config
custom_provider_slug: build a canonical slug for a custom provider display name
get_provider_full: get a complete ProviderDef for a provider including transport, auth, and base URL info
